title: Total refunded amount by payment method
prompt: Support wants total refunded amount by payment method. Payments start at one row per payment — what do you need a row to represent instead?
grain: Starts at one row per payment; ends at one row per payment method.
metricDefinition: sum(amount) for refunded payments, grouped by method.
referenceSql: SELECT method, sum(amount) AS total_refunded FROM payments WHERE status = 'refunded' GROUP BY method
